change.name: Change: Rate, Accumulation, and Flow
change.truth: Things change. Change accumulates. Accumulation flows.
change.qfep_connection: Foundation — the calculus substrate. Derivative as instantaneous rate of change, integral as accumulated quantity, vector field as flow. The conceptual vocabulary that forces, wavefunctions, randomness, and noise will all use.
change.formula: f'(x) = lim_{h→0} (f(x+h) - f(x)) / h; ∫_a^b f(x) dx = F(b) - F(a); F = grad ϕ (vector field as gradient of a scalar)
change.demonstration: Watch a tangent line slide along a curve and read its slope. Pump up the count on a Riemann sum and watch rectangles converge into a continuous integral. Release particles into a vector field and watch them flow. Take over the catalyst and sustain its contact on a target — accumulation made bracelet-felt.
change.description: The calculus substrate, made visible. Change as instantaneous rate (derivative); accumulation as continuous addition (integral); vector field as flow at every point in space. This sequence's job is to establish the vocabulary so forces, wavefunctions, randomness, and noise can name what they're doing instead of running on an unintroduced backbone.
learning_objectives: Change as instantaneous rate: the derivative; slope of a curve at a point; velocity as rate of position
Slope across a curve: how slope itself becomes a function (derivative-as-function)
Accumulation as continuous addition: the integral; area under a curve; total from rate
Riemann sum: discrete accumulation approaching continuous; how rectangles become integrals in the limit
Vector fields: change-and-flow at every point in space; the first encounter with a function of space (not just time)
The fundamental theorem of calculus: change and accumulation are inverse operations; one undoes the other
Carry-forward to forces and waves: F = ma is calculus made physical; sine is the function whose second derivative is itself negated
content: Change_Intro: rate — how fast, right here: the tangent, the slope, the velocity arrow, the terrain whose steepness you read with your feet
Accumulation_Riemann: accumulation — the rate added up: rectangles under a curve, the pump that fills, pi found by counting
Flow_Field: flow — a rate at every point at once, and the particles that make it visible
Change_Reconciliation: reconciliation — the two were one operation read in opposite directions (the FTC bridge), which closes the loop back onto rate
change._provenance: Proposed 2026-05-13 via doc/sequence_proposals/2026-05-13_change-sequence.md. Follows from the math-density sieve pass (doc/sieve_passes/2026-05-13T09-15-00_math-density.md) — addresses the calculus shadow running across forces / wavefunctions / randomness / noise. Maps and artifacts are placeholder names; build follows the spine-walker editing pattern.

artifact_groups.rationale: Open with the most concrete change: a tangent line sliding along a curve. The number on the tangent IS the derivative. Code panel shows f(x) and f'(x) side by side.
Animate a particle. Position over time = the curve. Velocity arrow = the derivative made physical. player_trace from primitives reappears here as the path-becomes-function move.
Extend derivative from curve to surface. Partial derivatives shown as slope arrows in x and y. Sets up vector field as the next move.
Shaded area under a curve. Slider moves the right boundary; area readout tracks. Accumulation as a function of the upper bound — the integral as a function.
Player adjusts partition count; rectangles converge to a continuous integral. Reuse riemann_pi from QFEP lab as a finite example: π from a Riemann sum.
A 2D grid of arrows for f(x,y) = (vx, vy). Presets for rotational / divergent / wavy. Player can dial through them.
Release particles into the field. They follow streamlines. Make flow felt as motion-through-rule.
The Fundamental Theorem of Calculus made animated: take derivative, then integrate, return to original. Same for the other direction. The bridge that connects every prior map.

Catalyst chamber. The bracelet acquires the sustain affordance: hold orb contact to accumulate effect. First foe demonstrates the new way of engaging — same goo, but tickled by sustained contact rather than impact.

change.deferred_reason: THE FOLD, 2026-08-25. Eight rooms, seven of them 10x11, held 27 artifact placements between them — two to five each, which is a corridor with a thing in it, not a room. Folded to the four rungs the map names were already spelling. Checkable: python tools/fold_ledger.py --sequence=change --plan=doc/folds/change.json --check

taxonomy._readme: THE LADDER (2026-08-25). FOUR rungs, and the fourth is the loop: reconciliation shows that rate and accumulation were the same operation read in opposite directions, so the walk ends where it started knowing why. The rungs were already in the map names — the fold only stopped spending three rooms on one idea.
taxonomy.1_rate: how fast, right here? — tangent, slope, velocity, the partial derivative you read off a terrain with your feet. THE ROOM IS Change_Intro (20x20, 170 floor cells, the only room in the sequence with space to be one), which absorbed Change_Velocity and Change_Slope_Surface.
taxonomy.2_accumulation: what does a rate add up to? — Riemann rectangles, the pump that fills, pi counted out. THE ROOM IS Accumulation_Riemann; Accumulation_Area folded in without a single orphan, because integral_area already stood in both.
taxonomy.3_flow: what if the rate is everywhere at once? — the field, and the particles that make it visible. THE ROOM IS Flow_Field, which took particle_flow_swarm from Flow_Particle_Pulse.
taxonomy.4_reconciliation: when do the two meet? — the fundamental theorem: differentiation and integration are one operation read in opposite directions. THE ROOM IS Change_Reconciliation (ftc_bridge). The loop closes on rung 1.
taxonomy._next_door: forces rung 4 (motion) is this sequence read in a body — velocity is the first derivative and acceleration the second — and forces rung 5 (force) hands the walk back here. The spine has change at 4 and forces at 5 for that reason.
taxonomy._still_thin: Flow_Field holds 3 and Change_Reconciliation 3 after the fold. The fold made the sequence honest, not full — those two rungs want more artifact, which is a separate job.
